ci_support_linux_64_.yaml:
channel_sources:
- conda-forge
channel_targets:
- conda-forge main
docker_image:
- quay.io/condaforge/linux-anvil-x86_64:alma10

about.description:
PgJDBC is the official PostgreSQL JDBC driver: a pure-Java (Type 4) driver
that lets Java programs connect to PostgreSQL using standard, database
independent Java code. This build bundles the SCRAM client (relocated under
org.postgresql.shaded, as in the published jar) so SCRAM-SHA-256
authentication works out of the box. The jar is installed to
share/liquibase/lib, which Liquibase auto-loads; other Java tools can add
$CONDA_PREFIX/share/liquibase/lib/postgresql.jar to their classpath.

org.postgresql.shaded, as in the published jar) so SCRAM-SHA-256

name: pgjdbc
raw_meta_yaml:
# yaml-language-server: $schema=https://raw.githubusercontent.com/prefix-dev/recipe-format/main/schema.json
schema_version: 1

context:
  version: "42.7.14"

package:
  name: pgjdbc
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://repo1.maven.org/maven2/org/postgresql/postgresql/${{ version }}/postgresql-${{ version }}-jdbc-src.tar.gz
  sha256: 1f38e5e32f1e9b2200f6c0e7cce02d635d7bc14b35dff803a52e09cd666a16b9

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: generic

requirements:
  build:
    - maven
    - openjdk 17.*
  run:
    - openjdk >=8

tests:
  - package_contents:
      strict: true
      files:
        exists:
          - share/liquibase/lib/postgresql.jar
  - requirements:
      run:
        - openjdk 17.*
        - liquibase
        - ripgrep
    script:
      env:
        LIQUIBASE_ANALYTICS_ENABLED: "false"
      content:
        - if: unix
          then:
            - java -jar "${PREFIX}/share/liquibase/lib/postgresql.jar" | rg --fixed-strings "${{ version }}"
            - jar tf "${PREFIX}/share/liquibase/lib/postgresql.jar" | rg --fixed-strings "org/postgresql/shaded/com/ongres/scram/client/ScramClient.class"
          else:
            - java -jar "%PREFIX%\share\liquibase\lib\postgresql.jar" | rg --fixed-strings "${{ version }}"
            - jar tf "%PREFIX%\share\liquibase\lib\postgresql.jar" | rg --fixed-strings "org/postgresql/shaded/com/ongres/scram/client/ScramClient.class"
        - liquibase --version | rg --fixed-strings "postgresql.jar"

about:
  homepage: https://jdbc.postgresql.org/
  repository: https://github.com/pgjdbc/pgjdbc
  documentation: https://jdbc.postgresql.org/documentation/
  summary: PostgreSQL JDBC driver (pgjdbc)
  description: |
    PgJDBC is the official PostgreSQL JDBC driver: a pure-Java (Type 4) driver
    that lets Java programs connect to PostgreSQL using standard, database
    independent Java code. This build bundles the SCRAM client (relocated under
    org.postgresql.shaded, as in the published jar) so SCRAM-SHA-256
    authentication works out of the box. The jar is installed to
    share/liquibase/lib, which Liquibase auto-loads; other Java tools can add
    $CONDA_PREFIX/share/liquibase/lib/postgresql.jar to their classpath.
  license: BSD-2-Clause
  license_file:
    - LICENSE
    - third-party-licenses/

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - rxm7706
    - pb01ka
